# Xcode

Xcode is AppleΓÇÖs integrated development environment (IDE) for macOS, used to develop software for iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS. It includes a suite of tools for designing user interfaces, writing and testing code, and debugging applications. Xcode supports multiple programming languages such as Swift and Objective-C and offers features like a source editor, version control, performance analysis, and extensive documentation, making it a comprehensive platform for developing Apple ecosystem apps.
